Package com.eloview.sdk.networkManager

Class Network

java.lang.Object
com.eloview.sdk.consts.Consts
com.eloview.sdk.accountManager.AccountManager
com.eloview.sdk.networkManager.Network
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Network extends AccountManager
Network class provides the following functions.
  • A method called setNetwork which is used to connect to a user-defined network configuration
  • A method called getNetwork which returns the information about the current network the device is connected to, such as the network name, network type, IpAddress and MacAddress
  • A method called getWiFiMac which returns the WiFi Mac Address
  • A method called getEthernetMac which returns the Ethernet Mac Address
  • A method called installCertificate This method is used to send the EST Certificate configuration request. It will generate EST user and ca_certificate.
  • A method called removeCertificate This method is used to send the EST Certificate configuration request. It will remove EST user and ca_certificate.
  • A method called installLocalCertificate This method is used to install the local wifi certificates even when device is offline.
  • A method to power on/off the ethernet port. setEthState
  • A method to obtain the DHCP server host name getDHCPServerHostName
  • A method to unregister the broadcast receiver registered when the installCertificate(Context, ESTConfig, Handler) API is used in your application unregisterCertificatesListener
  • A method to read system property readSystemProperty

    • getNetwork

      public void getNetwork(android.content.Context context, String accessToken, android.os.Handler handler)
      This method is used to provide information about the network the device is currently connected to. This method does not necessarily return all the parameters defined
      in the NetworkConfig class. The parameters returned for each interface are mentioned below.
      Parameters:
      context - Context
      accessToken - An authentication token received from the Elo servers.
      handler - A handler to receive one or more of the following callback messages:

      AccountManager.TOKEN_VERIFY_FAIL
      Consts.GENERIC_ERROR
      GET_NETWORK_RESPONSE_CODE

      If the device is connected to Ethernet: The following parameters will be returned:
      "active", "networkType", "macAddress", "ipAddress", "networkPrefixLength", “interface”, “proxyPort”, “ipAssignmentState”,
      "proxyHost", “gateway”, “networkPrefix”, “dnsServers”, “proxyExclusion”

      If the device is connected to Wifi: The following parameters will be returned:
      "active", "networkType", "ssid_name", "macAddress", "ipAddress", "networkPrefixLength", “interface”, “proxyPort”, “ipAssignmentState”,
      "speed", "rssi", "proxyHost", “gateway”, “networkPrefix”, “dnsServers”, “proxyExclusion”

    • installLocalCertificate

      public boolean installLocalCertificate(android.content.Context context, CertificateConfig certificateConfig)
      This method is used to install the local wifi certificates even when device is offline. Provide CA or USER certificate file path, name and CERTIFICATE_TYPE. User certificates are generally in ".p12" format and require a valid password to be installed.
      Parameters:
      context - Context it must be Activity or Application context
      certificateConfig - CertificateConfig Configuration of the local certificate files having local certificate file path, name, type. user_certificate_password if CERTIFICATE_TYPE is USER_CERTIFICATE.
      Returns:
      boolean true if certificate installed successfully.

    • registerCallback

      public void registerCallback(com.elo.secure.IElosecureCallback iElosecureCallback)
      Registers a callback to receive asynchronous responses from EloSecure network operations.

      The callback's updateData(String msg) method receives a JSON string with the format:

       {
   "action": "com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_*",
   "RESPONSE_VALUE": "<result>"
 }

      Possible Action Values for Network Operations

      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_ETH_STATE - Ethernet state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_HOTSPOT_ACCESSIBLITY_ENABLE_DISABLE - Hotspot state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RES_SET_AUTO_ELOVIEW - Auto EloView state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_BLUETOOTH_PAIRING_CONFIRMATION - Bluetooth pairing result

      Example Usage

       IElosecureCallback callback = new IElosecureCallback.Stub() {
     @Override
     public void updateData(String msg) {
         try {
             JSONObject json = new JSONObject(msg);
             String action = json.getString("action");
             String value = json.getString("RESPONSE_VALUE");
             Log.d("Callback", "Action: " + action + ", Value: " + value);
         } catch (JSONException e) {
             e.printStackTrace();
         }
     }
 };
 network.registerCallback(callback);
      Parameters:
      iElosecureCallback - The callback to register for receiving async responses.
      See Also:
      • unregisterCallback(IElosecureCallback)
